Question
========
Wheelan illustrates what key concept in the chapter "Inference: Why My Statistics Professor Thought I Might Have Cheated?" from the book *Naked Statistics: Stripping the Dread from the Data*?

Answerlist
----------

* That unusually accurate results can raise suspicion, but statistical inference helps assess whether they are likely due to chance

* That statistical inference can be used to prove someone’s guilt beyond reasonable doubt

* That hypothesis testing is not useful in criminal investigations

* That cheating can be detected by comparing mean scores across different groups
